segments.t: A sudden panic strikes the kitchen of Claude Monet as Chef Barinov's young daughter Alisa vanishes without a trace. While the staff scrambles to check every corner and security camera, Barinov receives an unexpected phone call from her mother. Let's listen to their conversation in Russian.
